name: Koyasu Mana
source:
She is the beloved daughter of the executive director who is looking for a job. She has an honest and pure-hearted personality, probably due to her parents' discipline.

She is also a bit of a klutz, which makes you want to protect her. When she visits a company as a recruiter, she meets the main character and...?
